battery_note: Li-ion batteries (HS2012 code 850760) validated at AUC 0.93 in the 2017-2024 HS2017 run; absent from this HS2002 panel.
note: Predictive test of B: does product-space density at t0 rank the countries that ACQUIRED each downstream product (RCA crossed 1) by t1 above those that did not? ROC-AUC 0.5 = no skill, 1 = perfect. Split by tier -- CAPABILITY-driven (specialty alloys, manufactured goods) vs COMMODITY/energy-sited (bulk smelting/ferroalloys, sited by cheap power & ore, not capability). Density is expected to predict the capability tier and not the commodity tier. Exploratory: few entrants per product; it bounds trust in B, does not certify it.
